shared_elements: repeated motifs arranged in a horizontal band/register
raised framing edge around the carved field
figures with heads turned in profile
justification: Both are stone surfaces worked in low relief that combine profile animal figures with a strip of repeated units running horizontally across the field (the rosette frieze along the bottom in A, the row of arch-like loops along the top in B), and both frame the figural field with a raised border. Beyond that generic scheme they diverge sharply: A is a smoothly modelled, proportionally naturalistic scene of a horse, wheeled vehicle and human figures rendered with fine internal detail, while B is a schematic, flat-outlined array of isolated creatures cut with blunt, rounded contours on an irregular pillar, with no shared subject matter or narrative logic.
